title: NEVERMORE
tagline: a trail followed twice, a vow made twice

dramatic.two_seconds_before: a trail followed twice, a vow made twice. Before frame 1 we are already inside 'WASHED ASHORE': the city was moving before the camera arrived, so the opening beat is a stimulus already in progress, not a cold start.

beats.verb: something in the world changes — cloud against sky
beats.line: What if I followed this trail, to where the broken pieces have washed ashore — and the ashes of expired wildfires cover sands, and debris lifted from the night sea water’s floor.

beats.verb: the change is registered — sky against
beats.line: The waves calm to folded whispers; the winds mute the trees. The right level of silence, to find a throbbing heart — it used to be mine. I lift it with care: nevermore.

beats.verb: an internal decision forms — the figure against person, building, street lamp
beats.line: The plants in a golden hue bloom, and face toward me in anticipation. The weeds repel, falling into the shadows where our memories hide — and mean so little, in a moment of defeat — as I’m called forward.

beats.verb: the body/camera loads against the coming move — the figure against person, building, street lamp
beats.line: The clouds mute the stars for the deepest level of darkness — welcoming extra hard work, to search the bare ground for two hands.

beats.verb: the move reaches its extreme — the figure against person, street lamp, building
beats.line: Hands that once could touch dust after dusk, and feel good — they too used to be mine. I put them back on, with the care of my future at stake: nevermore.

flip_test.note: keys must differ enough to tell the story with no in-betweens
